title: Hamahoonch Drum Circle Rythm Gathering
desc:
This will be a very special Hamahoonch circle, held as part of Notations Festival.

The Hamahoonch community will play alongside guest musicians who have come to Yerevan for the festival from 27 countries. Expect a circle unlike any we’ve done before.

There are no individual drum reservations for this event. Seven drums will be reserved for the guest musicians, who will take turns playing them, while the remaining drums will be shared among the Hamahoonch community. Please come ready to share, take turns, and be considerate of everyone who wants to play.

This is going to be an awesome one.

title: FINITE FOREVER | LIBRARY
desc:
LIBRARY

We live in a world that tells us to hold on to everything, yet the things we value most—memory, time, and experience—cannot be held on to forever. This project is a shared digital space based on one principle: permanence is finite, but it can be taken from someone else.
Participants move freely through the space, adding and placing marks and objects. Nothing here is permanent by default — everything slowly drifts toward abstraction, existing but becoming unrecognizable unless someone chooses otherwise.

Making something permanent is making a claim. The space asks, "What's one thing you want to stay here?" But permanence is limited. Once it runs out, keeping something forever means taking that permanence from someone else.
Nothing ever fully disappears. What fades becomes residue—a trace of what it once was. What to keep, what to let go, and what to take. Unlike the space itself, this record does not fade.

The space forgets. The ritual remembers.

title: 100 Winds
desc:
Join a global network orchestra of up to 100 wind musicians. This international remote performance connects individual signals from around the world into a central system in Yerevan, transforming distance and network latency into a collective musical experience.

Open call details:
• Open to all wind instruments, genres, and backgrounds
• No virtuoso technique or advanced notation-reading required
• Based on simple rhythmic and harmonic patterns

The final composition will be broadcast during the Notations Festival. Deadline for applications is July 29. The registration link is available in the hosq bio.

title: Meta-Ritual | Performance
desc:
A cinemusical symphony combining original compositions, film and choreography into a hybrid performance – telling a story about two people who seem locked in their daily ritual. When the routine is broken, chaos ensues. Does structure control us, unite us or liberate us?

“Meta-Ritual” aims to build a deeper, more symbiotic relationship between sound, screen and stage – organically integrating the creative processes behind the key audiovisual elements, rather than developing each one separately in a conventional production workflow.

by Frederick Bernas (music, saxophone, film), Rhys Votano (visuals), Lubomir Andrei (dance), Christina Danielyan (dance), Arman Peshtmaljyan (keyboards), Fernando Damon (drums), Maria Aristakesyan (cello), Kino Pinto (guitar)
